entries.title: Exodus 25:1
segments: ¶And the Lord said to Moses,

entries.title: Exodus 25:2
segments: Say to the children of Israel that they are to make me an offering; from every man who has the impulse in his heart take an offering for me.

entries.title: Exodus 25:3
segments: And this is the offering you are to take from them: gold and silver and brass;

entries.title: Exodus 25:4
segments: And blue and purple and red, and the best linen, and goats' hair;

entries.title: Exodus 25:5
segments: And sheepskins coloured red, and leather, and hard wood;

entries.title: Exodus 25:6
segments: Oil for the light, spices for the sweet-smelling oil, sweet perfumes for burning;

entries.title: Exodus 25:7
segments: Beryls and stones of value to be put on the ephod and on the priest's bag.

entries.title: Exodus 25:8
segments: And let them make me a holy place, so that I may be ever present among them.

entries.title: Exodus 25:9
segments: Make the House and everything in it from the designs which I will give you.

entries.title: Exodus 25:10
segments: ¶And they are to make an ark of hard wood; two and a half cubits long, and a cubit and a half wide and high.

entries.title: Exodus 25:11
segments: It is to be plated inside and out with the best gold, with an edge of gold all round it

entries.title: Exodus 25:12
segments: And make four rings of gold for it, to be fixed on its four feet, two rings on one side of it and two on the other.

entries.title: Exodus 25:13
segments: And make rods of the same wood, plating them with gold.

entries.title: Exodus 25:14
segments: And put the rods through the rings at the sides of the ark, for lifting it.

entries.title: Exodus 25:15
segments: The rods are to be kept in the rings, and never taken out.

entries.title: Exodus 25:16
segments: Inside the ark you are to put the record which I will give you.

entries.title: Exodus 25:17
segments: And you are to make a cover of the best gold, two and a half cubits long and a cubit and a half wide.

entries.title: Exodus 25:18
segments: And at the two ends of the cover you are to make two winged ones of hammered gold,

entries.title: Exodus 25:19
segments: One at one end and one at the other; the winged ones are to be part of the cover.

entries.title: Exodus 25:20
segments: And their wings are to be outstretched over the cover, and the winged ones are to be opposite one another, facing the cover.

entries.title: Exodus 25:21
segments: And put the cover over the ark, and in the ark the record which I will give you.

entries.title: Exodus 25:22
segments: And there, between the two winged ones on the cover of the ark, I will come to you, face to face, and make clear to you all the orders I have to give you for the children of Israel.

entries.title: Exodus 25:23
segments: ¶And you are to make a table of the same wood, two cubits long, a cubit wide and a cubit and a half high,

entries.title: Exodus 25:24
segments: Plated with the best gold, with a gold edge all round it;

entries.title: Exodus 25:25
segments: And make a frame all round it, as wide as a man's hand, with a gold edge to the frame.

entries.title: Exodus 25:26
segments: And make four gold rings and put them at the four angles, on the four feet of the table;

entries.title: Exodus 25:27
segments: The rings are to be fixed under the frame to take the rods with which the table is to be lifted.

entries.title: Exodus 25:28
segments: Make rods of the same wood, plated with gold, for lifting the table.

entries.title: Exodus 25:29
segments: And make the table-vessels, the spoons and the cups and the basins for liquids, all of the best gold.

entries.title: Exodus 25:30
segments: And on the table at all times you are to keep my holy bread.

entries.title: Exodus 25:31
segments: ¶And you are to make a support for lights, of the best gold; its base and its pillar are to be of hammered gold; its cups, its buds, and its flowers are to be made of the same metal.

entries.title: Exodus 25:32
segments: It is to have six branches coming out from its sides; three branches from one side and three from the other.

entries.title: Exodus 25:33
segments: Every branch having three cups made like almond flowers, every cup with a bud and a flower, on all the branches.

entries.title: Exodus 25:34
segments: And on the pillar, four cups like almond flowers, every one with its bud and its flower:

entries.title: Exodus 25:35
segments: And under every two branches a bud, made with the branch, for all the six branches of it.

entries.title: Exodus 25:36
segments: The buds and the branches are to be made of the same metal; all together one complete work of hammered gold.

entries.title: Exodus 25:37
segments: Then you are to make its seven vessels for the lights, putting them in their place so that they give light in front of it.

entries.title: Exodus 25:38
segments: And the instruments and trays for use with it are all to be of the best gold.

entries.title: Exodus 25:39
segments: A talent of gold will be needed for it, with all these vessels.

entries.title: Exodus 25:40
segments: And see that you make them from the design which you saw on the mountain.
